records.label: spacr.attribution#10
records.source: **Two head shapes, one contract.** A spaCR classifier's head emits either one logit (binary; class 1 when the logit is positive) or ``C`` logits. Code that assumes one shape is wrong for the other, and silently so: attributing the raw logit of a single-logit head always explains *class 1*, so for an image the model called class 0 the map you get is the map for the class it rejected — the negation of what you asked for. Every method here goes through :class:`ClassScoreModel`, which presents a single logit ``z`` as the two-column view ``[-z, +z]``. Both classes then have a real gradient, ``target`` means the same thing for both head shapes, and no caller has to know which head it has.
records.context: **Two head shapes, one contract.** A spaCR machine-learning classification model's head emits either one logit (binary; class 1 when the logit is positive) or ``C`` logits. Code that assumes one shape is wrong for the other, and silently so: attributing the raw logit of a single-logit head always explains *class 1*, so for an image the model called class 0 the map you get is the map for the class it rejected — the negation of what you asked for. Every method here goes through :class:`ClassScoreModel`, which presents a single logit ``z`` as the two-column view ``[-z, +z]``. Both classes then have a real gradient, ``target`` means the same thing for both head shapes, and no caller has to know which head it has.
records.translation: **두 가지 헤드 형태, 하나의 계약.** spaCR 분류기의 헤드는 하나의 로짓(이진; 로짓이 양수이면 클래스 1)을 내보내거나 ``C``개의 로짓을 내보냅니다. 한 형태를 가정한 코드는 다른 형태에서는 틀리며, 그것도 조용히 틀립니다. 단일 로짓 헤드의 원시 로짓을 어트리뷰션하면 항상 *클래스 1*이 설명되므로, 모델이 클래스 0이라고 판단한 이미지에서는 얻은 맵이 모델이 거부한 클래스의 맵, 즉 요청한 것의 부정이 됩니다. 여기의 모든 방법은 :class:`ClassScoreModel`을 거치며, 이 클래스는 단일 로짓 ``z``를 2열 보기 ``[-z, +z]``로 제시합니다. 그러면 두 클래스 모두 실제 그래디언트를 가지고, ``target``은 두 헤드 형태에서 같은 의미이며, 호출자는 자신이 어떤 헤드를 가졌는지 알 필요가 없습니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.BarcodeSearchReport#0
records.source: Findings of one barcode search, with the reads examined per file.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.BarcodeTable#0

records.context: One reference table of named barcode sequences.
records.translation: 이름이 붙은 바코드 서열의 참조 테이블 하나.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.BarcodeTable#1
records.source: The sequences are held as a mapping from sequence to name so that a match can be named without a second search, and the per-length counts are kept because the chance rate depends on how many barcodes of each length there are rather than on the size of the table alone.

records.translation: 서열은 서열에서 이름으로의 매핑으로 보관되어 두 번째 검색 없이도 일치 결과에 이름을 붙일 수 있고, 우연 비율은 테이블 크기만이 아니라 길이별 바코드 수에 달려 있으므로 길이별 개수도 유지됩니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.BarcodeTable#2
records.source: the label this table is known by for the rest of the search, and the label every finding it produces refers back to.
records.context: the label this table is known by for the rest of the search, and the label every finding it produces refers back to.
records.translation: 검색의 나머지 동안 이 테이블이 알려지는 레이블이자, 이 테이블이 만드는 모든 결과가 거꾸로 가리키는 레이블.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.BarcodeTable#3
records.source: mapping from barcode sequence to the name of that barcode, so a hit can be named without searching the table again.
records.context: mapping from barcode sequence to the name of that barcode, so a hit can be named without searching the table again.
records.translation: 바코드 서열에서 그 바코드의 이름으로의 매핑으로, 테이블을 다시 검색하지 않고도 적중 결과에 이름을 붙일 수 있게 합니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.BarcodeTable#4
records.source: which part of the screen's identity the table decodes -- plate row, plate column, guide -- or None for a table searched without one.
records.context: which part of the screen's identity the table decodes -- laboratory microplate row, laboratory microplate column, guide -- or None for a table searched without one.
records.translation: 테이블이 해독하는 스크린 정체성의 부분 -- 플레이트 행, 플레이트 열, 가이드 -- 또는 역할 없이 검색한 테이블이면 None.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.BarcodeTable#5
records.source: where the table was read from, kept so a proposed mapping can name the file rather than the label.
records.context: where the table was read from, kept so a proposed mapping can name the file rather than the label.
records.translation: 테이블을 읽어 온 위치. 제안된 매핑이 레이블 대신 파일을 지정할 수 있도록 보관합니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#0
records.source: Search result for one reference table, read file and orientation.
records.context: Search result for one reference table, read file and orientation.
records.translation: 참조 테이블 하나, 리드 파일, 방향에 대한 검색 결과.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#1
records.source: The finding carries the chance rate and enrichment alongside the observed rate, so a caller does not have to recompute the coincidence rate.
records.context: The finding carries the chance rate and enrichment alongside the observed rate, so a caller does not have to recompute the coincidence rate.
records.translation: 결과에는 관측 비율과 함께 우연 비율과 농축도가 담겨 있어, 호출자가 일치 비율을 다시 계산할 필요가 없습니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#2
records.source: label of the reference table this finding is about.
records.context: label of the reference table this finding is about.
records.translation: 이 결과가 다루는 참조 테이블의 레이블.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#3
records.source: the role that table fills, or None when it was searched without one.
records.context: the role that table fills, or None when it was searched without one.
records.translation: 그 테이블이 맡은 역할, 또는 역할 없이 검색한 경우 None.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#4
records.source: the read file the table was searched against.

records.translation: 테이블을 검색한 대상 리드 파일.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#5
records.source: whether the table matched ``AS_GIVEN`` or ``REVERSE_COMPLEMENT``.
records.context: whether the table matched ``AS_GIVEN`` or ``REVERSE_COMPLEMENT``.
records.translation: 테이블이 ``AS_GIVEN``으로 일치했는지 ``REVERSE_COMPLEMENT``로 일치했는지 여부.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#6
records.source: where the table was read from, or None when it was supplied inline.
records.context: where the table was read from, or None when it was supplied inline.
records.translation: 테이블을 읽어 온 위치, 또는 인라인으로 제공된 경우 None.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#7
records.source: how many reads were examined to reach this finding.
records.context: how many reads were examined to reach this finding.
records.translation: 이 결과에 이르기까지 검사한 리드 수.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#8
records.source: how many of those reads contained a barcode from the table.
records.context: how many of those reads contained a barcode from the table.
records.translation: 그 리드 중 테이블의 바코드를 포함한 리드 수.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#9
records.source: ``hits`` divided by ``reads``.
records.context: ``hits`` divided by ``reads``.
records.translation: ``hits``를 ``reads``로 나눈 값.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#10
records.source: the rate the same table would reach by chance, given how many barcodes it holds at each length. The observed rate means nothing on its own; this is what makes it readable.
records.context: the rate the same table would reach by chance, given how many barcodes it holds at each length. The observed rate means nothing on its own; this is what makes it readable.
records.translation: 같은 테이블이 길이별로 가진 바코드 수를 고려할 때 우연히 도달할 비율. 관측 비율은 그 자체로는 의미가 없으며, 이 값이 있어야 해석할 수 있습니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#11
records.source: ``observed_rate`` divided by ``expected_rate``.
records.context: ``observed_rate`` divided by ``expected_rate``.
records.translation: ``observed_rate``를 ``expected_rate``로 나눈 값.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#12
records.source: earliest start offset counted as the barcode's usual position.
records.context: earliest start offset counted as the barcode's usual position.
records.translation: 바코드의 통상적인 위치로 간주되는 가장 이른 시작 오프셋.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#13
records.source: how many consecutive offsets that position covers.
records.context: how many consecutive offsets that position covers.
records.translation: 그 위치가 포괄하는 연속 오프셋의 수.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#14

records.context: the single commonest start offset, or None when nothing was found.
records.translation: 가장 흔한 단일 시작 오프셋, 아무것도 찾지 못했으면 None.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#15

records.context: the distinct lengths present in the table. The extraction window has to reach past the longest, not the modal one.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#16

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#17
records.source: how many distinct sequences the table holds.
records.context: how many distinct sequences the table holds.
records.translation: 테이블에 들어 있는 서로 다른 서열의 수.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#18
records.source: fraction of hits taken by the commonest single barcode. Near one, alongside a low ``distinct_barcodes_seen``, is the signature of a spurious match rather than a real one.
records.context: fraction of hits taken by the commonest single barcode. Near one, alongside a low ``distinct_barcodes_seen``, is the signature of a spurious match rather than a real one.
records.translation: 가장 흔한 단일 바코드가 차지한 적중의 비율. 1에 가까우면서 ``distinct_barcodes_seen``이 낮으면, 진짜가 아니라 가짜 일치의 특징입니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#20
records.source: why that verdict was reached, worded to be shown to a user.
records.context: why that verdict was reached, worded to be shown to a user.
records.translation: 그 판정에 이른 이유를 사용자에게 보여 줄 수 있게 쓴 문장.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.OrientationFinding#21
records.source: hit count at each start offset, for the histogram.

records.context: What the search learned that has no matching key is carried alongside.
records.translation: 검색이 알아냈지만 일치하는 키가 없는 것은 함께 전달됩니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.ProposedMapping#3
records.source: Callers must apply the orientations as well as the settings; a run that searches a table in the wrong orientation maps nothing.
records.context: Callers must apply the orientations as well as the settings; a processing session that searches a table in the wrong orientation maps nothing.
records.translation: 호출자는 설정뿐 아니라 방향도 적용해야 합니다. 테이블을 잘못된 방향으로 검색하는 실행은 아무것도 매핑하지 못합니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.ProposedMapping#4
records.source: A screen that decodes a barcode beyond the plate column, the guide and the plate row has no settings key waiting for it. The table chosen for every role is therefore listed among the reference tables, whether or not a key could be filled in for it.
records.context: A screen that decodes a barcode beyond the laboratory microplate column, the guide and the laboratory microplate row has no setting name waiting for it. The table chosen for every role is therefore listed among the reference tables, whether or not a structured-data name could be filled in for it.
records.translation: 플레이트 열, 가이드, 플레이트 행 외의 바코드를 해독하는 스크린에는 그것을 기다리는 설정 키가 없습니다. 따라서 각 역할에 선택된 테이블은 그것에 채울 키가 있었는지와 관계없이 참조 테이블 목록에 나열됩니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.ProposedMapping#6
records.source: the file whose reads the window offsets are expressed against, since offsets mean nothing without their frame.
records.context: the file whose reads the window offsets are expressed against, since offsets mean nothing without their frame.
records.translation: 창 오프셋이 기준으로 삼는 파일. 오프셋은 기준 틀이 없으면 아무 의미가 없기 때문입니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.ProposedMapping#7
records.source: mapping from role to the read file that established it.
records.context: mapping from role to the read file that established it.
records.translation: 역할에서 그것을 정한 리드 파일로의 매핑.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.ProposedMapping#8
records.source: mapping from table label to the orientation the run should search that table in.
records.context: mapping from table label to the orientation the run should search that table in.
records.translation: 테이블 레이블에서 실행이 그 테이블을 검색해야 하는 방향으로의 매핑.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.ProposedMapping#9
records.source: the table chosen for each role, listed whether or not a settings key exists to carry it, so a role with no key is not lost.
records.context: the table chosen for each role, listed whether or not a setting name exists to carry it, so a role with no structured-data name is not lost.
records.translation: 각 역할에 선택된 테이블. 이를 담을 설정 키가 있는지와 관계없이 나열되므로, 키가 없는 역할도 사라지지 않습니다.

records.source: tables the run has to reverse complement to recognise, because they were found in the second mate as stored.

records.translation: 인식하려면 실행이 역상보로 검색해야 하는 테이블. 저장된 그대로 두 번째 메이트에서 발견되었기 때문입니다.

records.label: spacr.barcode_search.ProposedMapping#12
records.source: what the search learned that has no home among the settings keys.

records.translation: 검색이 알아냈지만 설정 키 가운데 들어갈 자리가 없는 것.

records.source: Optical pooled screening images the same well twice: once at low magnification to read the barcodes, once at high magnification to measure the phenotype. records.translation: 광학 풀링 스크리닝(optical pooled screening)은 같은 웰을 두 번 촬영합니다. 한 번은 낮은 배율에서 바코드를 읽고, 한 번은 높은 배율에서 표현형을 측정합니다. 모든 세포를 둘 사이에서 짝지어야 하는데, 뻔한 방법 -- 이미지를 상관시키는 것 -- 은 통하지 않습니다. 픽셀이 대응하지 않기 때문입니다. 배율이 다르고, 염색이 다르며, 흔히 현미경도 다릅니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#2
records.source: What is preserved is the arrangement of the cells. Take three neighbouring cells and the shape of the triangle they form is unchanged by magnification, rotation and translation. So the cells are triangulated, each triangle is reduced to a descriptor that depends only on its shape, and the two sets are matched on those descriptors. The transform between the acquisitions falls out of the matched triangles, and the cells are paired under it.

So the cells are triangulated, each triangle is reduced to a descriptor that depends only on its shape, and the two sets are matched on those descriptors. The transform between the acquisitions falls out of the matched triangles, and the cells are paired under it.
records.translation: 보존되는 것은 세포의 배열입니다. 이웃한 세포 세 개를 잡으면 그것들이 이루는 삼각형의 모양은 확대, 회전, 이동으로 변하지 않습니다. 그래서 세포를 삼각분할하고, 각 삼각형을 모양에만 의존하는 기술자로 줄이며, 두 집합을 그 기술자로 짝짓습니다. 두 획득 사이의 변환은 짝지어진 삼각형에서 도출되고, 세포는 그 변환 아래에서 쌍을 이룹니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#3
records.source: Matching is mutual nearest neighbour with a distance limit: a pair is kept only when each cell is the other's nearest, and anything doubtful is dropped rather than assigned. A wrongly matched cell gives a real phenotype the wrong barcode, which silently corrupts a screen; a dropped one costs only statistical power, which more cells can buy back.
records.context: Matching is mutual nearest neighbour with a distance limit: a pair is kept only when each cell is the other's nearest, and anything doubtful is dropped rather than assigned. A wrongly matched cell gives a real phenotype the wrong barcode, which silently corrupts a screening experiment; a dropped one costs only statistical detection sensitivity, which more cells can buy back.
records.translation: 짝짓기는 거리 한계가 있는 상호 최근접 이웃 방식입니다. 각 세포가 서로에게 가장 가까울 때만 쌍을 유지하고, 의심스러운 것은 배정하지 않고 버립니다. 잘못 짝지어진 세포는 실제 표현형에 잘못된 바코드를 부여하여 스크리닝을 조용히 오염시키지만, 버려진 세포는 통계적 검정력만 잃고 이는 세포가 더 많으면 되찾을 수 있습니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_merge.triangle_descriptors#1
records.source: The descriptor is two numbers: the ratios of the two shorter sides to the longest. Scaling a triangle multiplies every side by the same factor, so the ratios do not move; rotating and translating it does not change side lengths at all. The descriptor therefore ignores absolute size and position, which are what differ between the two acquisitions.
records.context: The descriptor is two numbers: the ratios of the two shorter sides to the longest. Scaling a triangle multiplies every side by the same factor, so the ratios do not move; rotating and translating it does not change side lengths at all. The descriptor therefore ignores absolute size and position, which are what differ between the two acquisitions.
records.translation: 기술자는 두 개의 수, 즉 더 짧은 두 변과 가장 긴 변의 비입니다. 삼각형의 크기를 바꾸면 모든 변에 같은 인수가 곱해지므로 비는 변하지 않고, 회전과 이동은 변의 길이를 전혀 바꾸지 않습니다. 따라서 기술자는 두 획득 사이에서 서로 다른 절대 크기와 위치를 무시합니다.

records.source: ``(descriptors, vertex_indices)`` -- an ``(M, 2)`` array and the ``(M, 3)`` indices of each triangle's vertices, ordered so that vertex 0 is opposite the shortest side and vertex 2 opposite the longest. records.translation: ``(descriptors, vertex_indices)`` -- ``(M, 2)`` 배열과 각 삼각형 꼭짓점의 ``(M, 3)`` 인덱스. 꼭짓점 0이 가장 짧은 변의 맞은편, 꼭짓점 2가 가장 긴 변의 맞은편이 되도록 정렬됩니다. 이 순서 덕분에 짝지어진 두 기술자가 짝지어진 점도 함께 제공하며, 이것이 없으면 변환을 풀 수 없습니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#0
records.source: One object list for a well, sewn across window seams and numbered once.
records.context: One object list for a microplate sample position, sewn across window seams and numbered once.
records.translation: 웰 하나의 객체 목록으로, 창 이음매를 가로질러 이어 붙이고 한 번만 번호를 매깁니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#1
records.source: Segment, sew, number -- the three steps between a composite and an object table. The compose step gives a mosaic that is built a window at a time and never materialised whole; this is what segmentation and numbering do on top of it:
records.context: Segment, sew, number -- the three steps between a composite and an object table. The compose step gives a stitched image grid that is built a window at a time and never materialised whole; this is what segmentation and numbering do on top of it:
records.translation: 분할, 이어 붙이기, 번호 매기기 -- 합성과 객체 테이블 사이의 세 단계. 합성 단계는 한 번에 창 하나씩 만들어지고 전체가 한꺼번에 구체화되지 않는 모자이크를 제공하며, 분할과 번호 매기기는 그 위에서 이루어집니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#2
records.source: Segment once, on the composite, window by window.
records.context: Segment once, on the composite, window by window.
records.translation: 합성 위에서 창별로 한 번 분할합니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#3
records.source: Sew the labels across window seams. An object straddling a boundary is one object, matched on its well-frame centroid.
records.context: Sew the labels across window seams. An object straddling a boundary is one object, matched on its well-frame centroid.
records.translation: 창 이음매를 가로질러 레이블을 이어 붙입니다. 경계에 걸친 객체는 하나의 객체이며 웰 좌표계의 중심점으로 짝지어집니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#4
records.source: Number in the well frame, not per window. Per-window numbering would give two windows an object #1 apiece.
records.context: Number in the microplate sample position frame, not per window. Per-window numbering would give two windows an object #1 apiece.
records.translation: 창별이 아니라 웰 좌표계에서 번호를 매깁니다. 창별로 번호를 매기면 두 창이 각각 객체 #1을 갖게 됩니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#5
records.source: The compose step already handles half of the seam problem: :func:`spacr.ops_compose.windows_over` tiles with an overlap, and its contract is that the overlap exceeds the largest object. So a nucleus near a seam is not split between two windows -- it is seen whole by at least one of them, and usually twice. The job here is therefore deduplication, not reconstruction: find the observations that are the same nucleus and keep the one that saw all of it.
records.context: The compose step already handles half of the seam problem: :func:`spacr.ops_compose.windows_over` microscope image fields with an overlap, and its contract is that the overlap exceeds the largest object. So a nucleus near a seam is not split between two windows -- it is seen whole by at least one of them, and usually twice. The job here is therefore deduplication, not reconstruction: find the observations that are the same nucleus and keep the one that saw all of it.
records.translation: 합성 단계는 이미 이음매 문제의 절반을 처리합니다. :func:`spacr.ops_compose.windows_over`는 겹침을 두고 타일링하며, 그 계약은 겹침이 가장 큰 객체보다 크다는 것입니다. 따라서 이음매 근처의 핵은 두 창으로 쪼개지지 않고, 적어도 한 창은 그것을 온전히 보며 보통은 두 번 봅니다. 그러므로 여기서의 일은 재구성이 아니라 중복 제거입니다. 같은 핵인 관측을 찾아 그것을 온전히 본 관측을 남깁니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#6
records.source: Reconstructing an object from two partial masks means deciding how to union pixels across a seam, which is fiddly and lossy. Choosing between two complete masks is neither.
records.context: Reconstructing an object from two partial masks means deciding how to union pixels across a seam, which is fiddly and lossy. Choosing between two complete masks is neither.
records.translation: 부분 마스크 두 개에서 객체를 재구성하려면 이음매를 가로질러 픽셀을 어떻게 합칠지 정해야 하는데, 이는 까다롭고 손실이 있습니다. 완전한 마스크 둘 중에서 고르는 것은 둘 다 아닙니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#7
records.source: One failure remains and is reported: an object larger than the overlap, which every window clips. :func:`number` refuses those rather than emitting a fragment, because a fragment looks exactly like a small nucleus and would be counted as one for the rest of the run.
records.context: One failure remains and is reported: an object larger than the overlap, which every window clips. :func:`number` refuses those rather than emitting a fragment, because a fragment looks exactly like a small nucleus and would be counted as one for the rest of the processing session.
records.translation: 실패 하나가 남아 있으며 보고됩니다. 겹침보다 큰 객체로, 모든 창이 이를 잘라냅니다. :func:`number`는 조각을 내보내는 대신 이를 거부하는데, 조각은 작은 핵과 똑같아 보여서 나머지 실행 동안 핵 하나로 세어질 것이기 때문입니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#8
records.source: The ids are a join key, so they are assigned deterministically -- raster order on the well-frame centroid -- and not by iteration order over a dict or by whichever window happened to be segmented first. The contract is: "This id, and the centroid beside it, is the join key for every later phase." Two runs over the same data must produce the same numbers or nothing downstream can be compared.
records.context: The ids are a join structured-data name, so they are assigned deterministically -- raster order on the microplate sample position-frame centroid -- and not by iteration order over a key-value mapping or by whichever window happened to be segmented first. The contract is: "This id, and the centroid beside it, is the join structured-data name for every later phase." Two runs over the same data must produce the same numbers or nothing downstream can be compared.
records.translation: id는 조인 키이므로 결정적으로 배정됩니다 -- 웰 좌표계 중심점의 래스터 순서로 -- 딕셔너리의 반복 순서나 우연히 먼저 분할된 창에 따라서가 아닙니다. 계약은 다음과 같습니다. "This id, and the centroid beside it, is the join key for every later phase." 같은 데이터에 대한 두 번의 실행은 같은 번호를 만들어야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 하류에서 아무것도 비교할 수 없습니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects.number#0
records.source: One id per object, assigned in the well frame, deterministically.
records.context: One id per object, assigned in the microplate sample position frame, deterministically.
records.translation: 객체마다 하나의 id를, 웰 좌표계에서 결정적으로 배정합니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects.number#1
records.source: Raster order on the well-frame centroid -- top to bottom, then left to right -- rather than the order windows were segmented in. The id is a join key, so two runs over the same data have to produce the same numbers; ordering by anything the scheduler can vary would break that quietly and only in the results.
records.context: Raster order on the microplate sample position-frame centroid -- top to bottom, then left to right -- rather than the order windows were segmented in. The id is a join key, so two runs over the same data have to produce the same numbers; ordering by anything the scheduler can vary would break that quietly and only in the results.
records.translation: 창이 분할된 순서가 아니라 웰 좌표계 중심점의 래스터 순서 -- 위에서 아래로, 그다음 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로. id는 조인 키이므로 같은 데이터에 대한 두 번의 실행은 같은 번호를 만들어야 합니다. 스케줄러가 바꿀 수 있는 무엇으로든 정렬하면 이것이 조용히, 그리고 결과에서만 깨집니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects.number#2
records.source: Ids start at 1. Zero is background in every label image this came from, and an object numbered 0 would be invisible to any downstream mask comparison.
records.context: Ids start at 1. Zero is background in every label image this came from, and an object numbered 0 would be invisible to any downstream mask comparison.
records.translation: id는 1부터 시작합니다. 0은 이것이 나온 모든 레이블 이미지에서 배경이며, 번호가 0인 객체는 하류의 모든 마스크 비교에서 보이지 않을 것입니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects.number#3
records.source: from :func:`sew`.
records.context: from :func:`sew`.
records.translation: :func:`sew`에서 온 것.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects.sew#0
records.source: Group observations that are the same nucleus.
records.context: Group observations that are the same nucleus.
records.translation: 같은 핵인 관측을 묶습니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects.sew#1
records.source: Every group is one physical object. A nucleus in a window overlap is grouped from two (or four, at a corner) observations; one in a window's interior forms a group of one.
records.context: Every group is one physical object. A nucleus in a window overlap is grouped from two (or four, at a corner) observations; one in a window's interior forms a group of one.
records.translation: 모든 그룹은 하나의 물리적 객체입니다. 창 겹침 안의 핵은 관측 두 개(모서리에서는 네 개)에서 묶이고, 창 안쪽의 핵은 하나짜리 그룹을 이룹니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects.sew#2
records.source: An observation whose mask ran into an interior seam did not see the whole nucleus, so its area and centroid are both wrong. It is kept only long enough to be matched to a complete observation of the same nucleus and is then dropped in favour of it. A clipped observation matching nothing complete means no window saw that nucleus whole, which :func:`number` refuses.
records.context: An observation whose mask ran into an interior seam did not see the whole nucleus, so its area and centroid are both wrong. It is kept only long enough to be matched to a complete observation of the same nucleus and is then dropped in favour of it. A clipped observation matching nothing complete means no window saw that nucleus whole, which :func:`number` refuses.
records.translation: 마스크가 안쪽 이음매에 닿은 관측은 핵 전체를 보지 못했으므로 면적과 중심점이 모두 틀립니다. 같은 핵의 완전한 관측과 짝지어질 때까지만 유지되고 이후에는 그쪽을 택하고 버려집니다. 완전한 것과 일치하지 않는 잘린 관측은 어느 창도 그 핵을 온전히 보지 못했다는 뜻이며, :func:`number`가 이를 거부합니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects.sew#5
records.source: every window's view of every object in one well, already in well-frame coordinates. Order does not matter; the grouping is by geometry, not by arrival.
records.context: every window's view of every object in one well, already in well-frame coordinates. Order does not matter; the grouping is by geometry, not by arrival.
records.translation: 한 웰의 모든 객체에 대한 모든 창의 시점으로, 이미 웰 좌표계 좌표로 되어 있습니다. 순서는 상관없습니다. 도착 순서가 아니라 기하로 묶습니다.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects.sew#6
records.source: groups, each a tuple of observations, in no particular order -- :func:`number` imposes the order that matters.
records.context: groups, each a tuple of observations, in no particular order -- :func:`number` imposes the order that matters.
records.translation: 그룹. 각각 관측의 튜플이며 특정한 순서는 없습니다 -- 중요한 순서는 :func:`number`가 부여합니다.

records.context: Delegates the call itself to :func:`spacr.ops_sbs.call_reads`, which already normalises each cycle's channels and reports quality as the minimum over cycles -- "a barcode is only as trustworthy as its worst base". Repeating that here would be a second decoder to keep in step.
records.translation: 호출 자체를 :func:`spacr.ops_sbs.call_reads`에 위임합니다. 이 함수는 이미 각 사이클의 채널을 정규화하고 품질을 사이클 전체의 최솟값으로 보고합니다 -- "a barcode is only as trustworthy as its worst base". 이를 여기서 되풀이하면 보조를 맞춰야 하는 두 번째 디코더가 생깁니다.

records.source: Read-only UI housekeeping (``journal=False`` — a history refresh, a model scan) is cancelled and waited for exactly like everything else, but it never appears in the return value. It writes nothing, so there is no half-written artefact to protect, and a caller that treats it as a veto turns "the run-history list is still loading" into "the application cannot be closed". ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` answers a non-empty return by refusing to close *and showing a modal*: on a headless run — CI, a test shard — nothing can ever dismiss that modal, and the process spins in its nested event loop with no forward progress. A housekeeping job that outlived the screen which started it used to be enough to trigger it.

It writes nothing, so there is no half-written artefact to protect, and a caller that treats it as a veto turns "the processing-session history list is still loading" into "the application cannot be closed". ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` answers a non-empty return by refusing to close *and showing a modal*: on a headless run — CI, a test shard — nothing can ever dismiss that modal, and the process spins in its nested event loop with no forward progress. A housekeeping job that outlived the screen which started it used to be enough to trigger it.
records.translation: 읽기 전용 UI 정리 작업(``journal=False`` — 기록 새로 고침, 모델 스캔)은 다른 모든 것과 똑같이 취소되고 기다려지지만 반환값에는 나타나지 않습니다. 아무것도 기록하지 않으므로 보호할 반쯤 쓰인 산출물이 없고, 이를 거부권으로 취급하는 호출자는 "실행 기록 목록을 아직 불러오는 중입니다"를 "애플리케이션을 닫을 수 없습니다"로 바꿔 놓습니다. ``MainWindow.closeEvent``는 비어 있지 않은 반환값에 대해 닫기를 거부하고 *모달을 표시*하는데, 헤드리스 실행 — CI, 테스트 샤드 — 에서는 아무것도 그 모달을 닫을 수 없고 프로세스는 중첩된 이벤트 루프에서 진전 없이 맴돕니다. 이를 시작한 화면보다 오래 살아남은 정리 작업만으로도 예전에는 이 일이 일어나기에 충분했습니다.

Both arrive as a font change on the widgets whose resolved font moved, so the columns are re-measured there rather than being right only for the sheet that happened to be current at construction.
records.translation: 글꼴 배율을 실어 나르는 것은 스타일시트이고, 이는 이 위젯들이 만들어진 뒤에 애플리케이션에 설치됩니다 -- 환경설정을 저장하면 실행 중인 창에 다시 설치됩니다. 둘 다 해석된 글꼴이 바뀐 위젯에 글꼴 변경으로 도착하므로, 구성 시점에 우연히 현재였던 시트에만 맞지 않고 열이 거기서 다시 측정됩니다.

records.source: A widget's QSS font is resolved when it is polished, which for a screen built into a stacked page happens on the way to the first show. records.context: A widget's QSS font is resolved when it is polished, which for an application view built into a stacked page happens on the way to the first show. Measuring here as well as on the font change is what keeps a row that was never sent a font change -- because its own font was inherited whole -- from being sized by the default metrics.
records.translation: 위젯의 QSS 글꼴은 다듬어질 때 해석되며, 쌓인 페이지에 들어 있는 화면의 경우 첫 표시로 가는 길에 일어납니다. 글꼴 변경 때뿐 아니라 여기서도 측정하는 것은, 글꼴 변경을 한 번도 받지 못한 행 -- 자기 글꼴을 통째로 상속받았기 때문에 -- 이 기본 메트릭으로 크기가 정해지는 일을 막습니다.

records.label: spacr.restart_state#1
records.source: The restart record stores the current module, its settings, a summary of active runs, and the locations of any run folders. :func:`save` verifies the record before the current process exits, and :func:`take` consumes it when the new process starts so that stale state is not restored repeatedly.
records.context: The restart record stores the current module, its settings, a summary of active runs, and the locations of any processing-session folders. :func:`save` verifies the record before the current process exits, and :func:`take` consumes it when the new process starts so that stale state is not restored repeatedly.
records.translation: 재시작 기록은 현재 모듈, 그 설정, 활성 실행의 요약, 모든 실행 폴더의 위치를 저장합니다. :func:`save`는 현재 프로세스가 종료되기 전에 기록을 검증하고, :func:`take`는 새 프로세스가 시작될 때 이를 소비하므로 오래된 상태가 반복해서 복원되지 않습니다.

records.label: spacr.restart_state#2
records.source: Only the interface configuration is restored. Active computations do not resume after a forced restart; output written before the restart remains in the recorded run folders.
records.context: Only the interface configuration is restored. Active computations do not resume after a forced restart; output written before the restart remains in the recorded processing-session folders.
records.translation: 인터페이스 구성만 복원됩니다. 활성 계산은 강제 재시작 뒤에 재개되지 않으며, 재시작 전에 기록된 출력은 기록된 실행 폴더에 남습니다.
